subject.title: feat: Discord channel-per-agent binding display in Gateway UI (ZZ-20260311-005)

question: Which Gateway/Control UI read surface should own selected-agent route and ACP binding visibility?
rationale: The request adds a new core Gateway protocol namespace plus Control UI state, while current main already has config helpers and CLI binding inspection; the durable API boundary is a maintainer product and architecture choice.

options.title: Approve a normalized read model
options.body: Define a stable read-only binding list contract, whether named routing.list or placed under an existing namespace, then review the linked implementation against that contract.

options.title: Reuse existing config/agents data
options.body: Have the Control UI derive the display from the existing config or agents binding surface, reducing new protocol surface but coupling the panel to current config shape.

options.title: Defer UI binding display
options.body: Keep binding inspection in CLI/config for now and pause the fork PR until a broader Control UI routing plan exists.

recommendation.title: Approve a normalized read model
recommendation.body: Define a stable read-only binding list contract, whether named routing.list or placed under an existing namespace, then review the linked implementation against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent Gateway RPC/routing-surface history among the likely owners for this API boundary decision.
